editorial:
Ever had a boss who says something so vague it drives you crazy? That is exactly what happens here. You get to follow two office workers who hear their manager say he needs a report yesterday. While one worker just starts typing fast, the other one takes the phrase literally. He becomes obsessed with the idea that the boss actually wants the report sent back in time. It is a hilarious setup that turns a boring office job into a wild science experiment. The vibe is light and goofy, making it the perfect pick for a lazy Friday night when you just want to laugh at how far someone will go to please a bad boss.

The acting is great because the chemistry between the two leads feels real, and the pacing keeps you moving quickly toward the finish line. Some parts of the science talk get a bit confusing, but it does not really matter because the jokes land well. If you are into weird comedies with a sci-fi twist, you will love this.
endingExplained: At the end, the obsessed employee actually manages to send the report back in time, but it causes a huge mess in the present. The twist is that the boss never actually wanted time travel; he was just using a common phrase. The movie wraps up with the employees realizing their boss is just clueless. They finally hand in the report, and the time machine breaks, leaving them back in their boring office jobs.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves workplace comedies and weird science stories.
